title: Keep provider search working for tools without descriptions
prompt:
Fix only src/app/providers/page.tsx and add tests/providers-search-null-description.test.mjs. Evidence: sql/001_bazaar_schema.sql:65 permits a null tool description; src/app/api/bazaar/catalog/route.ts:63 returns t.description unchanged. In src/app/providers/page.tsx:223-230 the search filter calls t.description.toLowerCase() unconditionally once provider and display-name matches fail. A local render with a provider containing a null-description tool and an unmatched search term threw a toLowerCase TypeError. Searching an otherwise valid catalog can therefore break the provider page.

Represent description as nullable in this page's Tool type and treat an absent description as an empty string when matching. Preserve case-insensitive matches against provider names, tool display names, and real descriptions, together with existing empty-query behavior. Keep this fix local to the provider page; do not change the catalog contract, SQL, marketplace page, or shared production helpers.

Add behavioral node:test coverage for null and empty descriptions, unmatched queries, matches in each supported field, and the empty query. Exercise the actual page/filter through in-memory TypeScript transpilation and lightweight React hook/JSX stubs, or a test-only exposed local helper; avoid source-regex-only assertions. Run node --test tests/providers-search-null-description.test.mjs. Use fixtures and the existing TypeScript installation without new dependencies. No credentials, auth, payments, sends, deployments, migrations, workflows, or package.json changes. Do not commit or push; work on the assigned branch you are on.
